name: Pjatizvjozdochnyj kur'er i tuman, vonjayjschij mertvechinoj
original_name: Пятизвёздочный курьер и туман, воняющий мертвечиной
source: Alan is a delivery courier with a 4.7 rating and two days left to pay off his debt. Today, Almaty is shrouded in a strange fog that smells of death — a fog that, according to rumor, dissolves the boundary between the living and the dead. What should be a routine shift turns into a fight for survival: to clear his debt and earn those precious five stars, Alan must complete special orders while the city is swallowed by something dark and unexplainable. Will you help him reach his goal — or make him live through the worst shift of his life?
